[[File:Lasso-Ewoks_3.jpg|250px|thumb|A Quork uses a lasso to capture a [[Devil beast]]]]
A '''lasso''' was a type of primitive tool, consisting of a rope with a noose at one end. It was used for ensnaring moving creatures or even [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. The [[Quork/Legends|Quorks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used lassos when they needed to capture living beings during their raids.<ref name="E3 9">[[Ewoks (1985) 3|''Ewoks'' (1985) 3]]</ref> Similarly, the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] used wrist-mounted lassos when they wished to take "[[maleling]]s" as their new [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="infinitysend">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref> There existed more technologically advanced versions of those, such as the [[laser lasso]], which emitted a "[[Laser/Legends|laser]]" that could wrap around its intended targets.<ref name="LJ:TW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref>
